mapper.select: SELECT operation_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric * 100, 2) AS success_rate FROM user_operation_logs WHERE created_at >= CAST(#{startTime} AS timestamp) AND created_at <= CAST(#{endTime} AS timestamp) GROUP BY operation_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT module AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric * 100, 2) AS success_rate FROM user_operation_logs WHERE created_at >= CAST(#{startTime} AS timestamp) AND created_at <= CAST(#{endTime} AS timestamp) GROUP BY module ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT username AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric * 100, 2) AS success_rate FROM user_operation_logs WHERE created_at >= CAST(#{startTime} AS timestamp) AND created_at <= CAST(#{endTime} AS timestamp) GROUP BY username ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_operation_logs_archive SELECT * FROM user_operation_logs WHERE created_at < #{cutoffDate}
